termux.minimumAndroid: 7 (Android API 24 for the current master build configuration)

artifacts.name: yt-dlp
artifacts.license: Unlicense with MIT and ISC components (official release tarball)
artifacts.notes: The official Android installation guidance uses Python/pip in Termux. The official Linux aarch64 executable is a glibc Linux artifact, not an Android/Bionic artifact, and is not used here. The release tarball's bundled JavaScript components carry their upstream MIT/ISC notices.

artifacts.name: yt-dlp-ejs
artifacts.license: Unlicense with MIT and ISC components
artifacts.notes: Pinned by yt-dlp 2026.08.19. The package is pure Python/JavaScript data; the JavaScript runtime remains a separate dependency.

artifacts.name: ffmpeg
artifacts.license: GPL-3.0 for the pinned Termux configuration
artifacts.notes: The pinned Termux recipe configures --target-os=android and maps aarch64, arm, x86_64, and i686 Android builds. It also produces ffprobe from the same source package.

artifacts.name: python
artifacts.license: PSF-2.0 plus the licenses of bundled dependencies
artifacts.notes: Termux applies Android-specific build settings and patches; this is not the Windows Python runtime.

artifacts.name: node
artifacts.license: MIT plus the licenses of bundled dependencies
artifacts.notes: yt-dlp EJS documents Node 22 or newer as supported. The Termux recipe targets Android; this candidate must still be smoke-tested with the chosen yt-dlp/ejs pair on each target ABI.

artifacts.name: deno
artifacts.notes: Deno's official installation matrix lists macOS, Linux, and Windows x64/arm64 assets, not Android. The existing deno.exe is x86_64-pc-windows-msvc and cannot run on Android.
